description.zh:
放音编码。

- ACallX_Apre	A呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。
- ACallX_Ain	        A呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。
- ACallX_Bin	       A呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。
- BCallX_Bpre	B呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。
- BCallX_Ain 	B呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

description.en:
The audio prompt encoding.

- ACallX_Apre: The audio prompt encoding played to A before the call is connected when A calls X.
- ACallX_Ain: The audio prompt encoding played to A after the call is connected when A calls X.
- ACallX_Bin: The audio prompt encoding played to B after the call is connected when A calls X.
- BCallX_Bpre: The audio prompt encoding played to B before the call is connected when B calls X.
- BCallX_Ain: The audio prompt encoding played to A after the call is connected when B calls X.
- BCallX_Bin: The audio prompt encoding played to B after the call is connected when B calls X.

description.zh:
单通呼叫限制逻辑。取值：

- CONTROL_AX_DISABLE：A号码无法呼叫 X 号码。

- CONTROL_BX_DISABLE：B号码无法呼叫 X 号码。
description.en:
The one-way call restriction logic. Valid values:

- CONTROL_AX_DISABLE: Number A cannot call number X.

- CONTROL_BX_DISABLE: Number B cannot call number X.

description.zh: 顺振时长。单位：秒。取值范围为 5~20。
description.en: The sequential ringing duration. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 20.

description.zh:
可选	dtmf 按键配置，设置 AXB 中间号号码绑定时使用，可配置内容如下：

- endCallIvrPhoneNo：放音对象 A 或 B。
- waitingDtmfTime：放完第一段音后的最大等待时长，最大时长为 30 秒。
- maxLoop dtmf：按键不匹配，循环播放第一个放音文件的最大次数，最大循环次数为 5 次。
- step1File：第一个放音文件名称。
- step2File：第二个放音文件名称。
- validKey：合法按键值定义，如：1,2 只允许配置两个有效键值，用","分隔。
- waitingEndCall：运营商挂机等待时长，最大等待时长为 10 秒。
description.en:
Optional. The DTMF key configuration for 700AXB number binding. The following items can be configured:

- endCallIvrPhoneNo: The audio playback target, A or B.
- waitingDtmfTime: The maximum wait time after the first audio file is played. Maximum value: 30 seconds.
- maxLoop dtmf: The maximum number of times the first audio file is replayed when a key press does not match. Maximum value: 5.
- step1File: The name of the first audio file.
- step2File: The name of the second audio file.
- validKey: The valid key values, such as 1,2. Only two valid key values can be configured, separated by commas (,).
- waitingEndCall: The carrier hang-up wait time. Maximum value: 10 seconds.

description.zh:
号码绑定的过期时间。

> - 必须晚于当前绑定时间1分钟以上，时间精确到秒。
>- 号码绑定过期时间内，您可随时进行手动解绑。
>- 若您对正在通话中的号码进行解绑，不会影响本次通话。
description.en:
The expiration time of the number binding.

> - The expiration time must be at least 1 minute later than the current binding time, accurate to the second.
>- You can manually unbind the number at any time before the binding expires.
>- If you unbind a number that is in an active call, the current call is not affected.

description.zh:
工业互联网标识编码，与OrderID保持一一对应关系。

编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。

当业务使用方自行生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选。

> 
> - OrderId与IndustrialId两个字段按业务情况必选其一
description.en:
The industrial Internet identifier code, which has a one-to-one mapping with OrderId.

The code supports characters such as "." and "/" as domain separators. The code must not contain non-printable characters such as spaces or line breaks.

This field is required when the caller generates the industrial Internet identifier code independently.

> 
> - Either OrderId or IndustrialId is required depending on the business scenario.

description.zh:
是否开启 ASR 服务功能。取值：

- false：关闭（默认值）。

- true：开启。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the ASR service. Valid values:

- false: Disable (default).

- true: Enable.

description.zh:
用于表示业务使用方是否需要该号码绑定关系产生的所有通话媒体文件。取值：

- true：录音。

- false：不录音（默认值）。
description.en:
Specifies whether call recording files are required for all calls made through this number binding. Valid values:

- true: Enable recording.

- false: Disable recording (default).

description.zh:
业务订单编码。

- 该编码与真实业务订单是一一对应关系，且不可重复。

- 编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。

- 当业务使用方提交业务订单编码，由应用平台生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选。
> 
> - OrderId与IndustrialId两个字段按业务情况必选其一
description.en:
The business order code.

- This code has a one-to-one mapping with the actual business order and must be unique.

- The code supports characters such as "." and "/" as domain separators. The code must not contain non-printable characters such as spaces or line breaks.

- This field is required when the caller submits a business order code and the platform generates an industrial Internet identifier code.
> 
> - Either OrderId or IndustrialId is required depending on the business scenario.

descriptions.zh:
在调用此接口前，请确保您已在控制台购买隐私号。
您可以使用此接口给700AXB中间号绑定号码，也可以在控制台号码管理页面给700AXB中间号绑定A、B号码。
700AXB中间号，绑定号码前建议您先明确业务场景中的A角色和B角色。例如：在打车应用场景中，A是乘客角色，B是司机角色。

700AXB中间号主要应用在1对1场景下的隐私保护，客户把A号码和B号码通过号码隐私服务实现绑定关系，A拨打X转接到B，B拨打X转接到A；一个X号码可以供200对绑定关系复用，如A1XB1、A2XB2、A3XB3......，只要A、B用户手机号码不重复，一个X号码可同时绑定200组手机号码，通话也可以同时进行。

QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为5000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before invoking this operation, make sure that you have purchased a private number in the console.
You can use this operation to attach numbers for a 700AXB private number, or attach A and B numbers for a 700AXB private number on the Number Management page in the console.
Before attaching numbers for a 700AXB private number, determine the A role and B role in your business scenario. For example, in a ride-hailing scenario, A is the passenger and B is the driver.

The 700AXB private number is mainly used for privacy protection in one-to-one scenarios. You attach number A and number B through the Phone Number Protection service. When A calls X, the call is forwarded to B. When B calls X, the call is forwarded to A. A single X number can be reused by up to 200 binding pairs, such as A1XB1, A2XB2, A3XB3, and so on. As long as the phone numbers of A and B users are unique, a single X number can be bound to 200 groups of phone numbers simultaneously, and calls can also be made simultaneously.

QPS limit

The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 5,000 calls per second. Exceeding this limit will cause throttling, which may affect your business. Invoke this operation appropriately.
